title: Earth stays more than 2C above pre-industrial levels for six days in a row
caption:
Global temperatures stayed more than 2C above pre-industrial levels for six days in a row for the first time on record, preliminary Copernicus data show, peaking at 2.24C on Monday. Scientists point to warming from fossil fuels and a strong El Niño. The Paris targets refer to long-term averages, so the limit has not been formally breached, but scientists expect more days above 2C in the coming months.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
